name: Sonic Forces: Rival Rush
summary: Sonic Forces: Rival Rush is a motion-controlled battle racer for the Nex Playground, adapting Sonic Forces' racing gameplay to full-body motion controls and local two-player play. It is available through the Play Pass subscription.
